finalText:
Nothing before 02:14 but routine health checks — clean baseline. Now I have the full story.

**Redis died, and nothing gave the app a way out.**

At 02:14:07, the app lost its connection to Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379`. It fell back to hitting the store directly, but that store couldn't handle the load. Requests to `/orders` started timing out at 5 seconds, over and over, every few seconds, for the next 17 minutes.

The app kept trying to reconnect to Redis every 80 seconds. Every single attempt failed, 13 tries in a row, right up to the end.

With no caching and no working reconnect, the backlog of requests just kept growing. It crossed the 500-item limit at 02:29:12 and kept climbing past 568.

At 02:31:45, `worker-2` finally gave out. It exited with code 134, which means it crashed on an assertion failure, likely from running out of memory holding all those queued requests.

**What to check first:** why Redis at `10.0.0.12` went down at 02:14, and why the app has no circuit breaker or request-shedding when the cache disappears. Right now one dead dependency takes the whole app with it.
